title: Scene-graph matrix stack pushes projection/modelview to a fullscreen pipeline whose layout only declares a fragment push-constant block
fix_note: no upstream fix; the fixed variant follows the fix proposed in the issue (a per-PipelineLayout trait saying whether it takes the matrix push constants, checked by MatrixStack::record)
expected_finding: vkCmdPushConstants of the two mat4s (bytes 0..127, stage flags taken from the bound layout: FRAGMENT) on fullscreen_tonemap's layout, which declares only {FRAGMENT, 0, 16} (VUID-vkCmdPushConstants-offset-01795)
